intentionalDifferences: Control characters are refused in url; the recovered member is o().url(), which does not check them. The URL is printed here rather than handed to a window.
elicitationId must be non-empty so a later notice can be correlated; the recovered member only requires a string.

URL mode accepts no result content. The recovered result schema is mode-independent and permits scalar or string-array content, which this runtime's schema-validated object map cannot check without a schema.
The notice is an observation with no state; nothing correlates it with the originating request, and an unknown id is discarded silently rather than reported.
The person opens the URL: the recovered host hands it to its window, this terminal surface shows it.
notPorted: The pre-UI resolving hook's auto-answer path for a URL request is carried only as far as the existing Elicitation hook already goes; the admission throttle (maxAdmittedPerMinute), pendingElicitations counters and activeCallWatchdogs in the same recovered span are not ported.
The recovered UI's own URL opening, title/display_name/description fields and the front-end dialog are not part of the terminal surface.

driverDefect.notCausedByThisPackage: the pre-change driver fails the same way on the previous commit
driverDefect.method: declare the fixture server in the user layer (configuration) instead of the checkout layer (a decision), leaving permissions, features, hooks and mcpClient where they were
driverDefect.untouched: smoke-mcp-approval-cli.mjs, which tests the decision itself
driverDefect.notAffected: smoke-plugin-components.mjs declares its server through an installed plugin's own config and already passed
